what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Malaysia in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 5511 Malaysian asylum seekers, and Australia hosted 57.0% of them.
After Australia, the largest hosts are South Korea, New Zealand and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records one armed conflict for Malaysia: over Sabah territory with the Sultanate of Sulu in 2013.
The fact pack does not give other reasons why people left Malaysia.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 240 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 21474, at the end of 2020.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2018 to 2024, and the figure was lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
